title: Previews: when a PR closes, its preview becomes a "this preview has closed" page
body:
When a PR closes (merged or not), its preview stops being a live copy of the site.

- **`.github/workflows/preview-cleanup.yml`**, on `pull_request: closed`:
  - re-uploads `pr-<N>` with `preview/closed/index.html`, a short "This preview has closed" page linking to the live site, with no game, relay or idea box;
  - marks the PR's `preview` deployments inactive, so GitHub stops showing an active deployment.
- **Why:** old previews stayed online forever, joining the real relay with old code and able to file real ideas. Cloudflare has no command to delete a preview alias; uploading over one replaces it. It also keeps at most 1,000 aliases per Worker.
- It shares the `preview-<N>` concurrency group with the Preview workflow without cancelling it, so a last upload finishes before the preview is closed.

## Tested

- Both steps run by hand on the closed PRs #21 and #23–#28:
  - each `pr-N` now shows the closed page;
  - their 7 deployments are inactive;
  - open #20 is untouched;
  - the Worker's own address is unchanged.
- The workflow itself runs for the first time when this PR closes. The `pr-<this>` preview should turn into the closed page.
